requirements.title: apiPackages lists every package PRD 12 changed or added
requirements.rationale: The change detector must cover each package whose exported surface PRD 12 changed or added, and must keep the existing sections where they are.

criteria.action: declare apiPackages as exactly the ten entries ".", "core", "tools", "codemode", "workspace", "guard", "provider/faux", "sandbox", "codesearch", "mcpserve", in that order
criteria.contract: TS-24-1 compares apiPackages element by element with this list and passes

setup: internal/policy/layout_test.go declares apiPackages
check.pseudocode: want = [".","core","tools","codemode","workspace","guard","provider/faux","sandbox","codesearch","mcpserve"]; assert len(apiPackages)==len(want); for i: assert apiPackages[i]==want[i]

criteria.action: contain exactly one `== <pkg>` header for each apiPackages entry, in apiPackages order, with no header for any other package
criteria.contract: the sequence of header lines in internal/policy/testdata/exported-api.golden equals apiPackages

setup: internal/policy/testdata/exported-api.golden is committed
check.pseudocode: hdrs = [l[3:] for l in lines(golden) if l.startswith('== ')]; assert hdrs == apiPackages

criteria.condition: go test ./internal/policy runs with AGENTKIT_UPDATE_API_GOLDEN unset
criteria.action: compare the exported API of all ten apiPackages entries with the committed golden and pass without skipping
criteria.contract: TS-13-67, TS-14-44, TS-15-42 and TS-17-61 each report PASS

setup: AGENTKIT_UPDATE_API_GOLDEN is unset in the environment
the committed golden has ten sections
check.pseudocode: out = run('go test ./internal/policy -run ... -v', env minus AGENTKIT_UPDATE_API_GOLDEN); assert exit==0; for id in ids: assert '--- PASS: ' contains id; assert 'SKIP' not in out

criteria.condition: a directory listed in apiPackages does not exist in the repository
criteria.action: fail the test instead of skipping the entry
criteria.contract: the test reports FAIL with an error message that contains the missing directory's path

setup: a re-executed child test process (selected by an environment variable) that calls exportedAPI on a directory path that does not exist under the repository root
check.pseudocode: missing = root/'no-such-pkg'; out, err = runChild(env MISSING_DIR=missing); assert err != nil; assert 'FAIL' in out; assert 'SKIP' not in out; assert missing in out

criteria.action: keep its separate preSpec17Guard list unchanged from spec 22 and keep comparing guard's exported lines against it, in addition to the golden comparison over apiPackages
criteria.contract: preSpec17Guard holds the same entries as after spec 22, and TS-17-61 passes

setup: preSpec17Guard in exported_api_17_test.go as spec 22 left it
check.pseudocode: assert preSpec17Guard[0]=='func Allow(programs ...string) core.BeforeToolCall'; lines=set(exportedAPI(t, root/'guard')); for e in preSpec17Guard: assert e in lines

requirements.title: The new golden sections record the PRD 12 additions
requirements.rationale: Each new section has to show the identifiers that made the package join the golden, as exportedAPI prints them.

criteria.condition: exportedAPI is called on the guard directory
criteria.action: return a non-empty list that contains a line beginning `func Allow(`
criteria.contract: TS-24-2 finds the line in the returned []string

setup: repoRoot(t) resolves the repository root
spec 22 and spec 23 have landed
check.pseudocode: for pkg, prefixes in {guard:["func Allow("], provider/faux:["func ToolCall(","func Text("], sandbox:["func Open("], mcpserve:["func New(","type Endpoint"]}: lines = exportedAPI(t, root/pkg); assert len(lines)>0; for p in prefixes: requireLine(t, pkg, lines, p)

criteria.condition: exportedAPI is called on the provider/faux directory
criteria.action: return a non-empty list that contains a line beginning `func ToolCall(` and a line beginning `func Text(`
criteria.contract: TS-24-2 finds both lines in the returned []string

criteria.condition: exportedAPI is called on the sandbox directory
criteria.action: return a non-empty list that contains a line beginning `func Open(`
criteria.contract: TS-24-2 finds the line in the returned []string

criteria.condition: exportedAPI is called on the codesearch directory
criteria.action: return a non-empty list that contains a `func New(` line whose parameter list includes `*workspace.Workspace`, and that keeps the Windows-stub declarations from stub_windows.go as separate lines beside the real ones
criteria.contract: TS-24-2 finds a `func New(` line containing `*workspace.Workspace`; the codesearch golden section lists the declarations exactly as exportedAPI prints them, with no normalization of receiver names

setup: codesearch/index.go and codesearch/stub_windows.go both exist
spec 20 has changed New to take *workspace.Workspace
check.pseudocode: lines = exportedAPI(t, root/codesearch); assert any(l startswith 'func New(' and '*workspace.Workspace' in l); assert any('func (idx ' in l); assert any('func (*Index)' in l)

criteria.condition: exportedAPI is called on the mcpserve directory
criteria.action: return a non-empty list that contains a line beginning `func New(` and a line beginning `type Endpoint`
criteria.contract: TS-24-2 finds both lines in the returned []string

criteria.condition: exportedAPI returns an empty list or lacks a required line for any of guard, provider/faux, sandbox, codesearch or mcpserve
criteria.action: fail and name the package and the missing line prefix
criteria.contract: the test reports FAIL with a message that contains the package directory and the expected prefix

setup: the requireLine helper used by TS-24-2
a child test process that calls it with an empty list for `guard` and prefix `func Allow(`
check.pseudocode: out, err = runChild(); assert err != nil; assert 'guard' in out and 'func Allow(' in out

requirements.title: No exported identifier or behaviour changes
requirements.rationale: The spec only widens the detector. If the existing sections stay unchanged, that is the evidence that nothing exported moved.

criteria.action: keep the five existing sections (., core, tools, codemode, workspace) byte-identical to the sections spec 23 committed, so that the regeneration diff contains only the five appended new sections
criteria.contract: the golden diff against the spec 23 commit contains no removed or changed line and only added lines after the workspace section

setup: the committed golden
git history is available with the spec 23 commit as an ancestor
check.pseudocode: for pkg in first5: assert section(golden, pkg) == exportedAPI(t, pkg); diff = git diff <pre-spec-24> -- golden; assert no line startswith '-' and not '---'

criteria.action: for any apiPackages entry, produce the same sorted, deduplicated lines on repeated calls over an unchanged tree, so that regenerating the golden twice in a row yields byte-identical files
criteria.contract: two consecutive runs of AGENTKIT_UPDATE_API_GOLDEN=1 go test ./internal/policy -run TS13_67 leave the golden with the same bytes

setup: an unchanged working tree
check.pseudocode: for pkg in apiPackages: a = exportedAPI(t, pkg); b = exportedAPI(t, pkg); assert a == b; assert a == sorted(a); assert len(set(a)) == len(a)

criteria.condition: the exported API of an existing section's package differs from the committed golden
criteria.action: fail and list the lines the package gained and lost, instead of absorbing the change
criteria.contract: the test reports FAIL with "exported API gained:" and/or "lost:" followed by the differing lines

setup: the golden is copied to a backup and restored by t.Cleanup
one line of the `core` section is removed from the golden (not run in parallel with other policy tests)
check.pseudocode: backup = read(golden); defer write(golden, backup); write(golden, drop_line(backup, core_section)); out, err = run(...); assert err != nil; assert 'exported API gained:' in out and dropped in out

criteria.condition: the regenerated golden has been committed
criteria.action: find no uncommitted change under internal/policy/testdata
criteria.contract: git status --porcelain -- internal/policy/testdata prints nothing and TS-19-64 passes

setup: the regenerated golden has been committed
check.pseudocode: assert run('git status --porcelain -- internal/policy/testdata') == ''; assert run('go test ./internal/policy -run TS19_64').exit == 0

requirements.title: Module checks and generated docs stay green
requirements.rationale: The doc-comment edits must leave every module checking clean, with committed generated docs. The documentation in PRD R2–R7 (the erratum entry, the README contract, the architecture data flow, the stale-identifier sweep and the measurement record) is delivered as task steps verified in review, because the steering forbids tests of documents.

criteria.condition: make check runs at the repository root
criteria.action: run fmt, vet, lint and test in every module listed in MODULES, including mcpserve, and finish without error

setup: the Makefile with spec 23's MODULES
check.pseudocode: mods = parse(make -pn | grep '^MODULES'); assert 'mcpserve' in mods; for tgt in [test, vet, lint]: out = make -n tgt; for m in mods: assert m in out

criteria.condition: make doc runs on the committed tree
criteria.action: regenerate docs/generated for every public package and leave no uncommitted change under docs/generated
criteria.contract: make doc exits with status 0 and git status --porcelain -- docs/generated prints nothing

setup: a committed tree
a git working directory
check.pseudocode: assert run('make doc').exit==0; assert run('git status --porcelain -- docs/generated')==''; assert exists docs/generated/mcpserve/*.txt or mcpserve.txt

criteria.condition: a module listed in MODULES fails fmt, vet, lint or test
criteria.action: stop and report the failing module
criteria.contract: make check exits with a non-zero status and its output names the failing module's step

setup: a temporary Go module in a temp directory whose only test calls t.Fatal
check.pseudocode: out, code = run('make test MODULES='+tmp); assert code != 0; assert 'go test ./... ('+tmp+')' in out

execution_paths.title: A maintainer widens the change detector and verifies it end to end

steps.action: runs AGENTKIT_UPDATE_API_GOLDEN=1 go test ./internal/policy -run TS13_67 with the ten-entry apiPackages
parses the non-test files of ., core, tools, codemode, workspace (spec 20), guard and provider/faux (spec 22), sandbox, codesearch and mcpserve (spec 23)
writes internal/policy/testdata/exported-api.golden with ten sections in apiPackages order and skips
commits the golden and runs go test ./internal/policy with AGENTKIT_UPDATE_API_GOLDEN unset
TS-13-67, TS-14-44, TS-15-42, TS-17-61, TS-19-64, TS-24-1 and TS-24-2 all pass against the committed golden

real_components: exportedAPI parsing the real source directories of all ten packages
setup: spec 20 to 23 code is in the tree
the golden is in a temporary copy of the committed state so the original can be restored
end_state: the regeneration run skips and writes a golden with ten `== <pkg>` sections in apiPackages order
the existing five sections are unchanged
a second regeneration produces byte-identical bytes
smoke.pseudocode: run update; assert headers == apiPackages; cp golden g1; run update again; assert golden == g1; run all policy tests unset; assert exit 0

execution_paths.title: A maintainer checks every module and regenerates the generated docs

steps.action: runs make check at the repository root
runs fmt, vet, lint and test in each module in MODULES, including mcpserve, and exits 0
writes go doc -all output for every public package to docs/generated, leaving no uncommitted change

setup: a committed tree containing spec 24's changes
go and make installed
end_state: make check runs fmt, vet, lint and test in each module in MODULES including mcpserve and exits 0
git status for docs/generated prints nothing
smoke.pseudocode: assert run('make check').exit==0; assert run('make doc').exit==0; assert run('git status --porcelain -- docs/generated')==''
